title: Indo Borax & Chemicals Limited: Q1 FY '27 FY27 Transcript Notes
key_takeaways: Acquisition defines the quarter, execution defines the future: Kronox Lab Sciences Ltd (64.26%) is the call’s strategic focus alongside the print.
Standalone print: Revenue ₹70.36 Cr (+31% YoY); PAT +59% YoY; EBITDA margin 28.1%.
Margin peak won’t fully carry: Q print 28.1% EBITDA vs FY guide ~20% (~810bps reset implied).
Full-year guidance: Revenue ₹250–260 Cr with ~20% EBITDA (FY27).
Catalyst: Kronox Lab Sciences acquisition completed.

sections.heading: The Kronox Lab Sciences Acquisition
bullets: Deal structure: 64.26% stake for ~₹250 INR cr.
